sections.heading: About Addictions Foundation Of Manitoba, Polaris Place, Northern Region

blocks.text: The Addictions Foundation of Manitoba (AFM) is a not-for-profit organization that helps people living with addiction and their families. AFM has locations in the northern region, including Polaris Place. This facility offers help for people suffering from drug and alcohol addictions, as well as mental health issues. It also provides support to family members who are affected by an addict’s addiction.

centre.name: Addictions Foundation Of Manitoba, Polaris Place, Northern Region
centre.about_html:
About Addictions Foundation Of Manitoba, Polaris Place, Northern Region

The Addictions Foundation of Manitoba (AFM) is a not-for-profit organization that helps people living with addiction and their families. AFM has locations in the northern region, including Polaris Place. This facility offers help for people suffering from drug and alcohol addictions, as well as mental health issues. It also provides support to family members who are affected by an addict’s addiction.

Polaris place is an integrated service centre giving a range for youth and adults as regards to alcohol, different medication and/or gambling. Services include: Prevention and Education Activities; Community-Based mostly Rehabilitation; Impaired Driver Program and Residential Rehabilitation Services.

AFM is a government-funded organization with the goal of being a leader in addiction treatment and encouraging healthy habits. With 28 locations across the province, AFM employs nearly 400 people and provides a variety of addictions services to Manitobans.

During their lifetime, at least 1 in every 5 Canadians has had issues with alcohol, drugs, or gambling. When someone close to them has these problems, it affects a large number of people. These challenges affect people of all ages and cultures, and they respond by improving their lives.

If you or someone you know is struggling with addiction or any other type of mental illness, please don’t hesitate to reach out for help at one of Addictions Foundation Of Manitoba locations near you!

Specialties

  • 12 Step Programs
  • Residential Drug Rehab
  • Outpatient Drug Rehab

Amenities

  • 12 Step Programs
  • Residential Drug Rehab
  • Outpatient Drug Rehab

Therapies

  • Holistic Therapy
  • Evidence-Based Practices
  • Yoga & Meditation
  • Individual Therapy & Counseling
  • Family Therapy & Counseling
  • Group Therapy & Counseling
  • Nutritional Counseling
  • Art & Nature Therapy
